response.sql: WITH per_record AS (SELECT CASE WHEN WBC IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN WBC >= 6.5 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS wbc_group, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CENTROMEA), ''), 'missing') AS centromea_status, GOT - GPT AS ast_alt, APTT - PT AS aptt_pt FROM Laboratory), per_status AS (SELECT wbc_group, centromea_status, AVG(ast_alt) AS avg_ast_alt, AVG(aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_pt FROM per_record GROUP BY wbc_group, centromea_status) SELECT AVG(avg_ast_alt) AS ast_minus_alt, AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM per_status;
